_comment: Copy to C:\AI\config\models.json and edit for the models YOU chose (docs/INSTALL-MODELS.md). Paths are relative to C:\AI\image-models. Profile keys are yours to choose (a profile named 'video' is the video model; 'edit' is the edit model). recipe = the sd-server recipe name for that model family (see stable-diffusion.cpp docs).
_ui_comment: OPTIONAL 'ui' block. Without it the page builds its image picker from your profiles. labels: key -> name shown. picker: [key, button label, note]. steps: key -> [min, max, default, hint]. alias: a picker key that runs another profile's weights. sampler: key -> extra sample_params sent with each request (see the model's stable-diffusion.cpp docs). sizeMp: key -> {draft, standard, high} megapixels. engines: names shown for voice and music. defaultModel / editProfile / fallbackProfile / preloadProfile: profile keys (preloadProfile = the one in 'preload').

picker: about N seconds on my GPU
